newsitem.title: CANADA: Stone-Cons takes more newsprint downtime.
newsitem.headline: Stone-Cons takes more newsprint downtime.

text.p: Stone-Consolidated Corp said on Wednesday that its Kenora, Ontario newsprint mill will take more temporary downtime to address an inventory imbalance.
The mill will be down for a three-week period beginning October 13 and will resume operations on November 3. The shutdown represents 19,000 metric tons of production loss.

The total reduction of newsprint produced at the company's facilities since January 1 amounts to 128,000 tonnes, excluding a 22,000-tonne loss incurred at its Port-Alfred mill in Quebec because of severe flooding in the region.
